name: state
meaning: InstantHooverState (1 idle, 2 dropped, 3 open, 4 anim)

name: suckRange
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTHOOVER_HORRANGE is loaded here and immediately overwritten with 300; capture radius for SuckMartians (3D) and CountMartiansInRange (horizontal)

name: vertRange
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTHOOVER_VERTRANGE; never read

name: dockRadius
meaning: inscribed radius (min half-extent on x/z) of the ACTIVEBOX pad found by FindDockBox; docking requires a smaller horizontal distance to the pad centre

name: openTimeMs
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTHOOVER_OPENTIME (ms) - length of state 3 (effectively halved, see engine notes)

name: hudIcon
meaning: GameRes 193 DAV_IDI_IGHICONC, drawn at (15,200)-(47,219)

name: hudDigits
meaning: GameRes 130 DAV_IDI_ITICPTR_, digit sheet for the remaining-Martian counter

name: martians
meaning: InstantMartian objects (class 145)

name: marvin
meaning: Marvin (class 193); msg 0x6480 arg = all Martians captured

name: sockets
meaning: InstantSocket objects (class 194); nearest one gets 0x6501 plug / 0x6502 unplug

name: dockedSocket
meaning: nearest socket at the last successful dock; only tested for non-NULL (msg 7), never cleared

name: martianCaptured
meaning: 1 once SuckMartians has taken martians[i]; Reset re-validates with msg 0x4C81

name: openTimerMs
meaning: ms spent in state 3 (incremented by g_dtMs twice per frame)

name: hudTint
meaning: HUD panel colour: g_uiTintColor, flashing to 0xAA0000 every other frame while a Martian is in range

name: capturedCount
meaning: Martians captured so far

name: martianCount
meaning: FindByClass(145) count (10 on Lvl-17)

name: socketCount
meaning: FindByClass(194) count

name: martianInRange
meaning: set in state 1 from CountMartiansInRange; written only, no reader in the class

name: docked
meaning: 1 after a successful dock in state 2; 0 on pickup/drop/Init/Reset. Gates HUD, sucking, the remote (msg 0x3F/0x71)

name: nextAction
meaning: InstantHooverNext: what state 4 does when the anim ends

name: dockBoxCount
meaning: count of the ACTIVEBOX id-list

name: dockBox
meaning: pad found by FindDockBox in the last state-2 frame

name: dockBoxes
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTHOOVER_ACTIVEBOX id-list (10 pads on Lvl-17)

name: homePos
meaning: = pos at Init; Reset returns here unless KEPT

name: soundHandle
meaning: vestigial: only ever zeroed; Reset calls Sound_Stop on it
